chunks: Hariz narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Whatever a slave in the state of ihram incurs during his ihram is upon the master, if he gave him permission to enter ihram.

key_terms.إِحْرَامِهِ: his state of ritual consecration for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.السَّيِّدِ: the master who has authority over the slave
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the slave or servant under ownership
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: the person in the state of ihram for hajj

ai.seo_question: Who is responsible for the liabilities of a slave in ihram if the master permitted the ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a slave who enters ihram with the permission of his master. Any liability resulting from the slave's actions in ihram falls upon the master when he authorized the ihram.
